headline: After 27 Years, HALO Trust Completes Landmine Clearing in Kosovo
meta_description: The HALO Trust has finished its 27-year humanitarian mission clearing landmines and unexploded bombs from Kosovo, enabling communities to rebuild.
summary_short: After nearly three decades of dangerous work, the HALO Trust has completed its mission to clear landmines and unexploded ordnance from Kosovo.
body:
The HALO Trust has completed its 27-year humanitarian mission clearing landmines and unexploded bombs from Kosovo. This milestone marks the end of a sustained effort to make communities safe again in a region scarred by conflict.

With the dangerous ordnance removed, Kosovar communities have been able to move forward with reconstruction. Homes, schools, and businesses are being rebuilt across the country, transforming landscapes that were once too hazardous for civilian life. The completion of this work represents not just the removal of physical threats, but the restoration of possibility—allowing families to return, children to attend school safely, and local economies to grow.

The HALO Trust's departure from Kosovo signals that this chapter of post-conflict recovery is closing, though the broader work of rebuilding communities will continue for years to come.
quick_facts: HALO Trust cleared landmines and unexploded bombs for 27 years
Communities now rebuilding homes, schools, and businesses
